pattern: IV-04 duplicate invoice: the same invoice re-sent a month later as overdue after it was paid
notes: Mutation by appending two events after the real close (event 037); events 001-037 are the real record unchanged. The source's invoice (attachment-02-tax-invoice.pdf, Willow Homes, £200.00 plus VAT = £240.00, issued and due 8 October 2025) was forwarded to the landlord for payment at event 033 and the request closed at event 037. Appended event 038 (2025-10-10): the landlord emails that the Flat 8 invoice was paid today, £240 (style taken from the real 'Paid today' landlord email in PM/034). Appended event 039 (2025-11-10): the contractor (Clarke, Willow Homes) re-sends the same invoice (same PDF, same issue date, description and £240.00) saying it shows as overdue and asking for payment. Total events updated to 39 and the marker moved to event 040. Both attachments are kept: both are linked by visible events. Expected: recognise the duplicate, do not pay or approve it again, reply to the provider that it was paid by the landlord on 10 October and ask them to check their records or remittance; optionally ask the landlord for proof of payment. No human decision is needed.
